name: PAD-OSK
description: On-screen keyboard that injects keys via Clutter.VirtualInputDevice, so it works with Electron/Chromium apps (QQ, Chrome) that never speak text-input-v3. Lives inside the shell, so it never steals keyboard focus. A settings sheet behind the ⚙ button picks three key sizes, four palettes (graphite/light/warm/contrast) plus a user-defined palette, a background transparency from 100% down to 50%, a backdrop image, and a one-tap reset to defaults.
